This '''patrol leader''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toma]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this [[Toma]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] encountered [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] and [[Banks's squadron|his squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as they trekked through the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="TEW" />
